title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Gym Guy. Tip #1
body: He goes six days a week and has an opinion about the seventh. Ask about the split and if he answers with a full weekly schedule unprompted, in detail, correct. If leg day genuinely happens, respect. If leg day is theoretical, look at the trousers. It's a sealed deal if he knows the exact hour his gym is empty and has built his life around it.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 Trail 5 walo, this is you.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Gym Guy. Tip #2
body: Watch the food. Chicken and rice in a container, at his desk, at one o'clock, every day, and he has stopped noticing that it's bleak. Ask about protein and whether it came from a shop, from Dubai in a cousin's suitcase, or from a man who sells it out of a car boot in G-9. It's a sealed deal if he has refused a plate at a family dinner and had to explain macros to a nani.
caption:
Tip #2 😭 Trail 5 walo, this is you.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Gym Guy. Tip #3
body: Ask what he weighs and then what he wants to weigh, because the gap is either four kilos or forty and neither man is content. There is a bulk and a cut and they follow a calendar he takes very seriously. Ramadan is a cut whether he planned it or not. It's a sealed deal if he shows people a photo from 2019 as motivation and it is genuinely a different person.
caption:
Tip #3 😭 Trail 5 walo, this is you.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Gym Guy. Tip #4
body: Watch the mirror situation. Not vanity, documentation. Same corner, same light, same day of the week, and most of them never get posted. There is a folder. The folder is between him and Allah. It's a sealed deal if he has retaken one because the light was different and it would have ruined the comparison.
caption:
Tip #4 😭 Trail 5 walo, this is you.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Gym Guy. Tip #5
body: Ask about supplements and see how far he goes. Creatine comes out immediately. Pre-workout comes with a laugh. Then there is a pause, and what follows the pause is the real answer. Everyone in every gym in this city knows who is on what and nobody says it aloud. It's a sealed deal if he says "bilkul natural" slightly too fast.
caption:
Tip #5 😭 Trail 5 walo, this is you.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Gym Guy. Tip #6
body: Look at where he trains. The big chains in F-8 and Blue Area are one crowd. The basement gym in a G-9 plaza with equipment from 1994 and a coach who has been there since it opened is a completely different one, and that second man is stronger. It's a sealed deal if his coach has been shouting the same four words at him for six years and it still works.
caption:
Tip #6 😭 Trail 5 walo, this is you.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Gym Guy. Tip #7
body: Ask about the trail. The serious ones do Trail 5 early, before the crowd, when the Margallas are cold and empty, and he will tell you it's the best hour of the day and he is right. He has a time he is trying to beat. It's a sealed deal if he knows which section always breaks him and plans his pace around it.
caption:
